writer: BackupCreationV1 via src/soma/security/backup/portable.py under CreatePortableBackup orchestration
verifier: BackupCreationV1 self_verify: reopen from disk, authenticate/decrypt every record, recompute digests/lengths, reconstruct isolated SQLCipher database, then call LLD-01 verify_restored_database before publication
temporary_policy: write only to a same-directory non-final temporary path owned by the current command; temporary/verification files never count as a completed backup and are removed best-effort on failure
finalization_policy: after cryptographic plus reconstructed-database verification succeeds, atomically rename the same-directory temporary artifact to the exact final destination before recording completed receipt/audit evidence
collision_policy: never overwrite an existing final path; a committed COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 replay may reuse the recorded final artifact only when reopening it proves the recorded SHA-256 still matches, otherwise fail closed rather than regenerate or replace
